examples.knowledge_point: Finding the Coefficient Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
examples.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
{\begin{aligned}x-2y=1 \\ 2y=-1\end{aligned}
$$
examples.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}x-2y=1 \\ 0x+2y=-1\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\left\lbrack
	\matrix {
		1 & -2 \
		0 & 2 
	}
	\right\rbrack
$$
